title: Outcome
description: A verifiable commercial outcome. Separates what is proved from what is only correlated.

type.description: A ladder that prevents confusing a positive reply with a meeting.
type.$comment: The last four rungs instantiate the `opportunity_stage_ladder` slot. No skipping: each step needs a dated, verifiable event.

occurred_at.description: The exact moment of the event, not of its entry.

evidence_ref.description: The thread or message that proves it. Without one, the outcome is not recordable.

verifiability.description: verified = a dated event with a primary source. correlated = associated but not causal. inferred = reconstructed, no direct artefact.
verifiability.$comment: Contractual anti-inflation field. Enforced by eval EV-TRUTH-01: an outcome without a primary source may not be recorded as verified, and a state may not advance on an inferred outcome.

attribution.description: unknown is a legitimate value. Real case: an unattributed calendar contact (ACCOUNT-F) that the campaign could not claim.
attribution.$comment: Contractual anti-inflation field. Enforced by eval EV-ATTRIBUTION-01: where the origin is not evidenced, the value is unknown, never the campaign.

attributed_touches.description: The message_id values that preceded the outcome. Allows measuring the weight of the follow-up.

time_to_reply_minutes.description: Observed metric: ACCOUNT-C replied in 38 minutes, ACCOUNT-A in 290.

amount.description: Only when invoiced or contracted. A verbal agreement stays null.
amount.$comment: Currency-agnostic: record the figure in the workspace's own currency. The reference motion's only agreed price was verbal, at cost, and never invoiced.
